text.en:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness.

After sprinting for 2 seconds, and if used while being airborne:
Shoulder Charge Abilities deal 225% increased impact damage.
Frozen enemies will not take increased Melee Damage while Peregrine Strike is active.

Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.

Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.

Peregrine Strike increases the Impact Damage of Shoulder Charge Abilities by 225%.

Against <link Minibosses [#CombatantClassifications] /> (inlcuding Champions and Tormentors), the buff is increased to 1000% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.

Provides no benefits when hitting <stasis/>Frozen enemies.
